eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Five
subtitle: Lesson 49 · Data Types, Strings, and Dates

caption: The server's current date and time.
Add an interval to a date — negative numbers go backward.

eyebrow: DATEDIFF — the gap between two dates
caption: Order matters — swapping start/end flips the sign of the result.

code:
SELECT OrderDate,
  DATEDIFF(DAY, OrderDate, GETDATE()) AS DaysSinceOrdered
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader
WHERE OrderDate > DATEADD(YEAR, -1, GETDATE());
caption: Orders from the last year, with days-since-ordered computed for each.
